body_html:
I spent my time digging through my archives trying to find my first #IndieWeb posts

My first (I think mention) of #IndieWeb on Twitter:

https://twitter.com/jgmac1106/status/524368379491004417

( Cant find the meme, but I wanna know how I turned Kevin Marks into a kid on bike shouting"I want my IndieWeb") 

I think this post about reclaiming academic publishing on December 2, 2015 was my first ever to mention #IndieWeb
https://jgregorymcverry.com/what-you-call-self-plagiarism-i-call-syndication/.

I installed this Known instance on 2015-02-19. I have 14 intances currently running. My first post: http://quickthoughts.jgregorymcverry.com/2015/03/07/transfering-my-back-stage-blog-from-to-here-hoping-posting

A post on trying to brigde #fedwiki #digped and #indieweb: http://quickthoughts.jgregorymcverry.com/2015/12/28/talking-fedwiki-to-think-about-digped-and-indieweb-unity 2015-12-19

First time using NoterLive to live blog an academic conference http://quickthoughts.jgregorymcverry.com/2015/12/04/live-blog-from-making-stuff-and-sense-at-lra15 2015-12-04

First time (of many more)trying to Tom Sawyer the #IndieWeb community: http://quickthoughts.jgregorymcverry.com/2015/09/17/hey-indieweb-help-me-find-sources-is-the-mobile-web 2015-09-17 of course Chris Aldrich was first to reply.
